description: Put one of the person's own WeInc websites live on the internet at its weinc.app address (or its connected domain), exactly like pressing Publish in the editor. Usually takes 15-45 seconds and returns the live link; if it takes longer it answers 'publishing' and website_details gives the live link shortly after. The site becomes public, so ask the person before calling this. The account's plan sets how many sites can be live at once; a refusal explains why.

projectId.description: Website id from my_websites or create_website_from_template.
